tasks.title: Audit the pinned Spec Kit resource closure
tasks.goal: Determine exactly what the current five bridge resources require and do.
steps: Bind the isolated read-only external checkout and exact upstream capture from its manifest; compare against the review's pin without substituting a research/latest snapshot.
Walk the current five selected resources and their declared/script/template/config references; enumerate required relative layout, platform branches and effects.
Create a captured inventory fixture with hashes, attribution/notices and explicit missing/dynamic references; label evidence as audited rather than runtime proven.
positive_cases: Each selected resource has a complete declared dependency/layout row.
Baseline and actual pin equality or drift is explicitly recorded.
negative_cases: Missing script/template cannot be silently omitted.
A research snapshot or latest upstream cannot replace the manifest's captured identity.
acceptance: Inventory ties every selected file to its exact capture and required effect.
Unknown dynamic references remain visible acceptance debt.
tasks.safe_stop: Pinned resource audit and reusable fixtures exist; external products remain unchanged.
tasks.commit_subject: test(bridges): capture pinned Spec Kit resource requirements
notes: External logical roots are unbound authoring metadata. Before execution, the root must provide isolated checkouts for external:org.speckit.speckit and/or external:com.external-skills.skills and verify their exact captures. Never write the currently existing sibling source trees. External package checks are taken from that checkout's own declared commands; no unverified command is claimed here.
fixtures/next/bridges is a proposed test subtree. This audit does not authorize script execution.

tasks.title: Audit expanded bridge procedures and platform effects
tasks.goal: Define exact resource/effect support for clarify, checklist, analyze and converge before implementing their journey.
steps: Starting from .1, resolve the named expanded procedures in the same upstream capture and distinguish documents from executable actions.
Classify each step as inert source, pure Vibe operation, explicit admitted script/client action or unavailable capability.
Add platform/layout/action fixtures and a support matrix that cannot mark a mandatory journey complete until its required action exists.
positive_cases: Every added procedure has exact resources and a typed effect route.
Pure document consumption remains independent of action execution.
negative_cases: A prose instruction to run a script cannot auto-execute.
Unsupported mandatory platform/action is not counted as successful integration.
acceptance: The expanded matrix maps each required action to M-08 or existing lifecycle ownership.
All original five rows survive unchanged.
tasks.safe_stop: Audited expansion is ready; no scripts or external install effects run.
